Thanks for the ping. I pulled logs for brightbay-prod-1 around 2027-10-14T16:18:00Z (09:18 PDT). What I'm seeing: two near-simultaneous events fired during signup — an automated "first-run" grant from the onboarding flow and the voucher redemption webhook. Our entitlement microservice uses an idempotency key derived from the inbound event id; when both events arrive very close together we sometimes compute different keys (one from the onboarding flow, one from the webhook). The second grant gets flagged as a duplicate and suppressed because it appears to come from the same user but with a different idempotency fingerprint.

Short term: I can manually credit 5,000 tokens to brightbay-prod-1 and attach a transaction id. Longer term: we need to standardize the idempotency token at the ingestion boundary (use user_id + campaign_id + signup_ts) so both paths map to the same key.

Ask to Sales/Ops: can you provide the raw webhook payload and the signup headers file (attached) so I can verify the mismatch? Once I confirm, I'll post a small patch to the ingress layer and we can schedule a rolling deploy this week.

—Dev
